description: QueryDef parameter round trip, floating types: the same PARAMETERS pV IEEESingle / IEEEDouble; SELECT pV AS V FROM One shape, for each of the r-wire cells of FSingle and FDouble (signed zero, subnormals, normal limits, infinities, quiet/signaling/negative NaN with payloads, widened and narrowed values; Arg tag R4 or R8 as in the cell). Asks the Parameter read-back and the V field tag and exact bits.
